(FIFTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th August, 2002]
No. Legis.1(18)/70-IX, dated
16-8-2002.---The following Ordinance
by the Governor of tile North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Fifth Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of section 158 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(FIFTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance
2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th August, 2002]
No. Legis.1(18)/70-IX, dated
16-8-2002.---The following Ordinance
by the Governor of tile North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:--
2. Substitution of section 158
of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of 2001.--In the North-West frontier
Province Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIV of
2001), for section 158, the following section shall be substituted, namely:
"158. Bar against
Nazimeen's dual membership.--A Zilla Nazim, Naib Zilla Nazim, Tehsil Nazim,
Naib Tehsil Nazim, Town Nazim Naib Town Nazim, Union Nazim and a Naib Union
Nazim may contest election for any political office after resigning from his
respective existing office before filing of his nomination paper:
Provided that a member of Zilla Council,
Tehsil Council, Town Council or Union Council may contest election for any
other political office without resigning from his respective existing office:
Provided further that all such members covered by the
foregoing proviso shall not hold more than one political office at a
time."
